page_title: COM 2-2 BOL | Como v Bologna 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Marco Piccinini is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Juan Miranda (Bologna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

90+9' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+7' Andrea Belotti (Como) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Piccinini interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+4' Matthias Braunoder (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+1' 2 - 2 Samuel Iling Junior (Bologna) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes inside the left post.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
88' Here is a change. Gabriel Strefezza is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Matthias Braunoder (Como).
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Luca Mazzitelli (Como) for Sergi Roberto.

86' What an opportunity! Andrea Belotti (Como) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
84' Marco Piccinini has a clear sight and sees a foul from Juan Miranda (Bologna). It's a free kick to Como in a dangerous position.
82' Alberto Moreno (Como) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
80' The substitution is prepared. Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolo Casale.
80' Substitution. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) replaces Jens Odgaard.
78' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Patrick Cutrone is replaced by Andrea Belotti (Como).
78' Alieu Fadera goes off the pitch and Lucas Da Cunha (Como) comes on.
76' 2 - 1 Goal! Santiago Castro (Bologna) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
72' Marco Piccinini shows the yellow card to Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) for a heavy challenge.

71' What a chance that is! Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the left post!
67' That will be all from Alberto Dossena who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Edoardo Goldaniga (Como).
66' Emil Audero pulls off a great save to deny Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
65' Como fail to score from a corner as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.

64' Alieu Fadera (Como) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Como.
63' The game is interrupted as Alieu Fadera (Como) is flagged offside.
63' Substitution. Samuel Iling Junior (Bologna) has come on for Riccardo Orsolini.
63' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Thijs Dallinga will be replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
62' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
59' Marco Piccinini sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
55' Wait! Referee Marco Piccinini has indicated he is going to review the Como goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
53' 2 - 0 Patrick Cutrone (Como) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
51' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
49' Flag goes up against Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
47' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Vincenzo Italiano gives a chance to Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) and Michel Aebischer is off.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Piccinini starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Alberto Moreno (Como) is booked.
45+4' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.
45+4' Handball! A player from Como handled the ball. Bologna win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Alessio Iovine (Como) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
44' Referee Marco Piccinini sees the trip by Stefan Posch (Bologna) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
43' A short pass finds Nico Paz (Como). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
42' Alessio Iovine (Como) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Piccinini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

40' Patrick Cutrone (Como) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
36' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Skorupski punches the ball away.

34' What a miss! The corner finds Alberto Dossena (Como) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
34' Good work from Como as they win a corner.

33' He should have scored! Patrick Cutrone (Como) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball goes out of play. Como are awarded a corner kick.
32' The linesman raises his flag. Nico Paz (Como) is adjudged offside.
30' The corner is swung in but Como can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
27' Nico Paz almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Alieu Fadera (Como) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
25' Stefan Posch (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Emil Audero comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.
22' The resulting free kick from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.

22' Alberto Moreno (Como) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Piccinini with no other option than to blow for a foul. Bologna get a free kick.
19' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Stefan Posch (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. Como are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
14' A cross from a corner kick by Como is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
13' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
12' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
10' The linesman signals that Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
5' 1 - 0 Own goal! Nicolo Casale (Bologna) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 1:0.
2' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) jumps into a tackle and Marco Piccinini signals a foul.
1' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' The match has just started.
Como will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Marco Piccinini.
